entities.summary: Michael Alexander Cloud is an American former professional football player who was a running back in the National Football League (NFL) for seven seasons. He played college football for the Boston College Eagles, earning consensus All-American honors. A second-round pick in the 1999 NFL draft, he has played professionally for the Kansas City Chiefs, New England Patriots, and New York Giants of the NFL.
